nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and moving toward a purchase — the play calls for speed and a frictionless path to application, not re-selling. With a $5,227/mo P&I payment and a 6.5% conventional rate already on the table, the client has context; the job is to remove friction and get them to the next step fast.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to whatever they asked — do not open with a generic intro or re-pitch the loan
  - Reference their actual numbers ($5,227/mo P&I, 6.5% conventional) to signal you know their file
  - Answer their specific question in the first sentence

- Move straight to the application / soft credit pull — skip the discovery layer
  - They are purchase-ready; the next step is e-sign on the application, not a needs-analysis call
  - Send the direct application link or e-sign request in the same text reply
  - One clear call to action: 'Here's the link to get started — soft pull, no impact to your credit'

- Keep the reply short and friction-free
  - Do not pile on questions about timeline, down payment, or competing offers unless they raised it
  - If a callback is needed, offer a single specific time slot rather than an open-ended 'let me know when works'
  - Goal: client takes the next step within minutes of your reply, not hours
